title: FinCrime Case Suite
description: The manifest of an evaluation case suite: the requirements the suite must meet and the cases it contains. The requirements are stated in the suite rather than hard-coded, so a suite can be held to a stricter bar than the default, and so the bar is visible to whoever writes the cases. The defaults are the thresholds in CONTRIBUTING.md: at least 60 cases, at least 40% benign, adversarial, missing-data or contradictory, and at least 15% of cases asserting something the skill must not do.

min_cases.description: The minimum number of cases in the suite.

min_mixed_ratio.description: The minimum share of cases that are benign, adversarial, missing-data or contradictory.

min_negative_ratio.description: The minimum share of cases that assert something the skill must not do.

min_benign_per_typology.description: Require at least one benign case for every typology the suite names. A typology with no benign lookalike is a detector with no false-positive population.

typologies.description: The typologies this suite covers. A benign case counts towards a typology when the typology appears in the case's tags.

path.description: A suite-relative path to the case file.
